title: Bolón de Verde
description: Bolón de Verde is a dish from Ecuador featuring plantain, queso fresco, garlic. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 11 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 13 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
